title: T1-T2 FSU NZ at 5 Nm, pooled Ulm database (Wilke 2025)

quantity.name: NZ
quantity.definition: full-range neutral zone, 3rd cycle; median with MAD

source.authors: Wilke HJ, et al. (Ulm in vitro database)
source.sample: pooled Ulm database: T1-T2 monosegmental FSUs with costovertebral joints (FE n=14, LB n=14, AR n=13); thoracic FSU pool 129 FSUs, donors 57 (37-80) y, 49 F/80 M

protocol.summary: Pooled data collection of Ulm in vitro tests 1995-2024 with standard pure moments (5 Nm thoracic), 1 deg/s, 3.5 cycles, 3rd evaluated; monosegmental thoracic FSUs (sources Liebsch 2020 Spine J and Liebsch 2022 Spine J) prepared with costovertebral and costotransverse joints and >=2 cm of ribs.
how_to_simulate: Model the FSU with disc, ligaments, facets and costovertebral/costotransverse joints with ~2 cm rib stumps
Fix caudal vertebra, apply pure moment +/-5 Nm to cranial vertebra, no preload
Report full-range rotation (flexion+extension, left+right) at peak moment
protocol.notes: POOLED DATABASE - overlaps Liebsch 2020 Spine J, Liebsch 2022 Spine J and (through Liebsch 2022, donors 1-25 originally tested at 7.5 Nm) probably Wilke 2017-era FSUs re-evaluated at 5 Nm. Do not pool with those studies. T12-L1 is classed lumbar in this paper. Full data in Supporting Information (not in download folder).

extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.1 deg medians, +/-0.15 deg MAD (automated pixel detection at 300 dpi, 22 px/deg); MAD null where whisker caps hidden
extraction.check_notes: Bar ends and ring centres checked visually on zoomed LB/FE crops (e.g. LB T1-T2 ROM 8.35, ring 4.95; FE T1-T2 ROM 8.26); MAD from symmetric cap pairs where both visible, else from the outer cap.

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (median as target)

ribcage.intact_structures: rib heads with costovertebral and costotransverse joints, >=2 cm rib stumps
